# Dripwriter Origin

> Free, open-source browser extension that types pasted text into Google Docs with believable human cadence: keyboard-neighbor typos that auto-correct, occasional false-start words that get deleted, configurable short breaks, and adjustable typing speed. Cross-browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox).

## What it does

Dripwriter Origin is a TypeScript / React browser extension built with the Plasmo framework. You paste a block of text into the popup, click into a Google Doc, and the extension types the text into the doc one character at a time — with cadence and humanization parameters you tune in the popup.

**Key capabilities:**
- Adjustable typing speed (20–150 WPM) with configurable variance
- Keyboard-neighbor typos that get auto-corrected (e.g., 'h' → 'g' → backspace → 'h')
- Occasional false-start words pulled from nearby context, typed and fully deleted
- Configurable short breaks at sentence boundaries
- Diagnostic mode that probes which typing event paths the current Google Docs build accepts
- All settings persisted to local browser storage; no accounts, no telemetry

## Who it's for

Writers, students, content creators, and demo authors who want pre-prepared text to appear in Google Docs as if it were being typed live. Useful for screencasts, reproducible drafts, typing-pace demos, and any context where a believable typing cadence matters more than instant paste.
